howTo.heading: How does our filedropshare work for sharing large file to anywhere?
steps: Select large file you want to share and upload it here.
As soon as we receive your file, a unique link and QR code will be displayed on your device screen.
Share this link or scan code on the device where you want to transfer this file.

faqs.question: How can I share files with end-to-end encryption?
faqs.answer: Our service works on peer-to-peer (P2P) technology without involving any server. This allows you to securely share files with end-to-end encryption directly.

faqs.question: Is there a limit on the size of files that can be shared?
faqs.answer: No, there is no file size limit for sharing. You can send and receive even larger files quickly, securely, and easily.

faqs.question: How can two devices connected with each other for sharing files?
faqs.answer: Once your large file is uploaded to FileDropShare, we generate a unique ID for it. You can share this ID with another device, allowing them to connect and transfer the file.

faqs.question: Is this a free file sharing website with no registration?
faqs.answer: Yes. FileDropShare is a free file sharing website where you can share files online without registration, login or account. Add your file, share the link or QR code, and the other person downloads it directly.

faqs.question: How do I share documents, PDFs and zip files online for free?
faqs.answer: Add any document, PDF, image, video or zip file, then copy the generated link and send it by email, chat or QR code. The receiver opens the link and downloads the file directly from your device.

faqs.question: How is a peer to peer file sharing site different from cloud file hosting?
faqs.answer: Cloud hosting stores your file on a company's server and gives you a download link. On a peer to peer file sharing site like FileDropShare the file moves directly between the two devices, so nothing is stored online and the link stops working once you close the page.

faqs.question: Where can I upload files for free to share them online?
faqs.answer: You can add your files right here on FileDropShare, free and without an account. Instead of uploading to a cloud server, the file is shared directly from your device, so you get a link instantly and the receiver downloads it straight away.
